# Quick feature template

The template moved into the `feature-quick` skill so the interview and the paste-in version share one copy:

[skills/feature-quick/references/quick-feature-template.md](../../skills/feature-quick/references/quick-feature-template.md)

- Interview: `/pm:feature-quick <idea>` in Claude Code, or invoke `feature-quick` in Codex.
- Paste-in: open the file above, copy the block between the two rules, fill it in, paste it into a session.

Every other template, with its checklist, mapping and output path: [TEMPLATES.md](../../TEMPLATES.md) at the plugin root.
